faqs.question: How does the Shared Team Inbox help my business?
faqs.answer:
Why it matters:
The Shared Team Inbox helps your business manage all customer conversations on WhatsApp / Instagram / RCS centrally. Rather than having team members engage with customers from separate numbers, the shared inbox streamlines conversations by allowing easy chat assignment, context sharing, and tracking of agent-wise performance.

How to use it in Interakt:
  • Go to the “Inbox” from the left navigation
  • Here, all customer chats are visible. You can switch between WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, Instagram Comments & RCS using the tabs on the top.
  • Multiple agents can view, manage, and respond to chats in real-time

faqs.question: How to ensure that agents only see their own chats?
faqs.answer:
a) If you’re not on the CRM plan / haven’t purchased the CRM add-on:
  • First, assign the Admin or Teammate role to the agent from the Agent Settings section.
  • Then, for the selected role (Admin / Teammate), make sure the following permissions are toggled off in the Role Permissions page under the Inbox section:
    • Allow access to All section
    • Allow access to Unassigned section
  • This will restrict the agent to only view chats assigned to them.
b) If you’re on the CRM plan / have purchased the CRM add-on:
  • Assign the agent the role of ‘Sales Agent’ from the Agent Settings page.
  • By default, Sales Agents will only see chats of contacts for whom they are assigned as the Account Owner.

faqs.question: How to ensure that some agents get to see all chats?
faqs.answer:
a) If you’re not on the CRM plan / haven’t purchased the CRM add-on:
  • You need to assign the Owner role to the agent (from Agent Settings section). Owners by default get to see all chats.
Note: Owner role can be assigned to an agent only by those members who themselves have the Owner role.

b) If you’re on the CRM plan / have purchased the CRM add-on:
  • Give the agent the role of ‘Superadmin’ from the Agent Settings page. Superadmins get access to all chats by default.

faqs.question: How to ensure team leads see their team chats?
faqs.answer:
• Team creation is currently only available in the CRM plan / CRM addon.
  • Teams can be created from the 'Manage Teams' page in Settings. While creating a team, it is mandatory to assign at least 1 member as the team-lead.
  • A team lead by default, gets to see chats of all agents who are part of their team.

faqs.question: How does agent assignment work in the Shared Inbox ?
faqs.answer:
How to assign in Interakt:
  • Open any chat in the Inbox
  • On the right panel, locate “Assign to Agent”
  • Click the dropdown and select the agent’s name
  • You may also assign chats to agents by right clicking on a chat from the chat list on the left.
  • Once assigned, only that agent will get notifications for the chat
  • Reassignment is possible anytime if needed.

faqs.question: What happens when a chat is closed?
faqs.answer:
Once a chat is closed, it no longer appears in the inbox chat list, allowing agents to focus only on open conversations. (To view closed chats, you can adjust the filters above the chat list.)

As a best practice, agents should close chats that no longer require any action. This keeps the inbox clean and organized by showing only actionable chats.

Note: Chat analytics are generated only after a chat is closed. To view them, go to Support → Chat Analytics from the left navigation menu.

faqs.question: How do closed chats reopen?
faqs.answer:
A closed chat will reopen if either the customer sends a message or an agent sends a message to the customer from the inbox.

Note:
  • Sending a campaign message to a customer (whose chat is closed) does not reopen the chat.
  • If the chat reopens due to a customer’s message, it remains assigned to the original assignee.

faqs.question: How can I start a chat with a new contact?
faqs.answer:
If the contact is already added to your Interakt account:
  • Click the search icon at the top of the chat list.
  • Enter the contact’s phone number and press Enter.
  • An empty chat window with that contact will appear.
  • Select a message template to start the conversation.

If the contact is not yet added to your Interakt account:
  • Go to the Contacts page and add the contact.
  • Once added, you’ll see a message icon next to the contact in the list.
  • Click the icon to open an empty chat with that contact.
  • Select a message template to start the conversation.

Note: It’s recommended to use a Utility template to initiate chats. Marketing templates often have lower delivery rates due to Meta’s per-user limit on marketing messages.

faqs.question: What are labels? Are tags & labels different?
faqs.answer:
Labels are identifiers assigned to specific conversations. Examples include: support chat, new sales chat, upsell chat, etc. Labels help group chats of a similar nature. You can filter your chat list using labels. However, filtering chats by tags is currently not supported.

Tags, on the other hand, are identifiers assigned to contacts. Examples include: high-value customer, frustrated customer, loyal customer, etc. Tags are useful for grouping similar contacts and are especially helpful when creating audiences for bulk campaigns.

In Summary:
  • Labels help identify and filter chats/conversations
  • Tags help identify and filter contacts

faqs.question: Can I automate chat replies?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can automate chat replies by navigating to the Automation section from the left-hand menu.

Interakt offers the following types of chat automations:
  • Welcome Message: Triggered when a new customer starts a chat, or when an existing customer messages after 24 hours.
  • OOO (Out of Office) Message: Sent when a customer messages outside your business hours.
  • Delayed Message: Sent if a customer’s message goes unanswered for a few minutes.
  • Custom Auto Replies: Automated responses triggered by specific keywords (FAQs). A compiled list of these keywords, known as the Interaktive List, can also be attached to the Welcome, OOO, or Delayed messages.
  • Workflows: Advanced chatbot flows that support conditional logic, branching, and API calls.

faqs.question: How do I see chats assigned to a particular agent?
faqs.answer: To see chats assigned to a particular agent, click on the filter icon on top of the chat list, on the left. You'll see the option to select particular assignees. Pick an assignee and click on 'Apply Filters'.

faqs.question: Where can I find customer details and notes while chatting in the Interakt inbox?
faqs.answer:
If you’re unable to quickly access customer info, past orders, or notes during a conversation, it can delay your response and affect service quality. Interakt’s inbox is structured to provide all essential context in one place.

How the layout helps in Interakt:
  • Left Panel (Chat List):
    View all ongoing conversations with names, previews, and status indicators.
  • Middle Panel (Chat Window):
    Read and respond to messages using templates, quick replies, attachments, and catalog items.
  • Right Panel (Customer Info & Smart Cards):
    Access customer contact details, lead source, tags, internal notes, and past order history.

faqs.question: How can I add new contacts?
faqs.answer:
You can add new contacts in the following ways:

One by One:
  • Go to Sales CRM → Contacts → Create Contacts
  • Fill in required details → Click Submit

Bulk Upload (up to 500,000 contacts per upload):
  • Go to Manual → Bulk Upload
  • Start by downloading the sample CSV to understand the required format.
  • The Country Code and Phone Number columns are mandatory.
  • You can include additional columns such as Name, Email, City, etc., for more contact details.
  • Upload your CSV and map each column to the appropriate field:
  • Ensure phone number and country code are mapped correctly.
  • Other fields can be mapped to existing ones or new fields can be created.
  • Once mapping is done, your upload should complete in a few minutes. For large files, it may take up to 1–2 hours.
  • A tag in the format ‘Csv upload <datetime>’ is automatically added to all uploaded contacts. Use this tag to filter and target these contacts in a campaign.

Download sample CSV → Fill it → Re-upload to import up to 500,000 contacts

Automatically:
  • Integrate with Track User APIs to add contacts. Postman Collection
  • Use Interakt's Out of the Box integrations with the below tools to auto-sync contacts from there into Interakt. All the below integrations should be available in the Integrations page:
    • Shopify
    • Facebook Leads
    • Google Sheets
    • Woocommerce
    • Zoho CRM
    • Hubspot

Note - For Shopify integrated accounts, the other integrations are not available currently.

faqs.question: How can I update existing contacts?
faqs.answer:
You can update contacts in 3 ways:

a) One-by-one (Manual Update):
  • Click on a contact in the list view.
  • Click Edit in the Contact Details panel on the right to modify the fields.
  • You can also add tags here.
Note: Phone Number cannot be edited.

b) Bulk Upload (via CSV):
  • If your CSV contains contacts that already exist in Interakt (matched by Phone Number + Country Code), those contacts will be updated with the new data.
  • To avoid overwriting unintended fields, only include columns for the fields you wish to update.

c) API Update:
  • Use the Track User API to update contact information.
  • If you call the API for a contact that already exists, details will be updated as per your API call.
  • Ensure you exclude any fields you don’t want to change.

faqs.question: How do I search or filter contacts, and what problem does it solve?
faqs.answer:
Search and filter features help quickly find relevant contacts.They solve the problem of navigating large contact lists and make segmentation or updates easier.

How to use them:
  • Go to Sales CRM → Contacts
  • Use the Search bar for names, numbers, or emails
  • Apply Filters (tags, teams, agents, status) for precision
  • Use the Actions menu to tag, export, assign, or delete contacts in bulk

faqs.question: How can I create new custom fields for my contacts?
faqs.answer:
Custom fields let you capture contact-specific details not covered by default fields.

How to add custom fields:

1. From the platform:
  • Go to Settings → Contact Settings → Custom Fields
  • Click Add Field
  • Select the field type (text, number, dropdown, etc.)
  • Name it and save—it appears across all contact profiles

2. Via Bulk Upload:
  • While doing the CSV upload, you'll be required to map the CSV columns to fields.
  • If you have a column for which no relevant field exists, you may choose to create a new field corresponding to that column.

3. Via APIs:
  • In the User Track API, you may pass a new field while adding a contact.

Note - Limits on Custom Fields might apply to your account depending on the plan you're on.

faqs.question: How do adding tags on contacts help?
faqs.answer:
Tags are labels used to group contacts. They solve the problem of poor segmentation and make it easier to run targeted campaigns.

How to tag contacts:
  • Go to Sales CRM → Contacts
  • Open a contact and go to the Tags section on the right
  • Add existing tags or create new ones
  • For multiple contacts, select them and use the More Actions menu to tag in bulk
  • Tags can also be added via the Track User API. Postman collection
  • Via CSV Upload: the same tag can be applied on all contacts in the CSV. However, via CSV upload, we currently don't support the addition of different tags for different contacts.

faqs.question: What is Lead Status & how to manage it?
faqs.answer:
The lead status field is used for tracking the stage of each contact (e.g., New, Contacted, Converted). This is available as a default field if you are on the CRM plan or if you have purchased the CRM add-on. Moreover, in the CRM plan / add-on, you also get access to a Lead Status Pipeline View & some reports based on Lead Status.

How to manage lead statuses:
  • Go to Settings → Contact Settings → Lead Statuses
  • Click Add Status → Name it, choose a color, and save
  • Drag to rearrange statuses as per funnel stage
  • To update for any contact:
    • Use the Status dropdown in Contact details
    • Or drag & drop in the Pipeline view
  • Set a default status from Basic Configuration for incoming leads

faqs.question: How do I assign account owners to leads and why is it necessary?
faqs.answer:
Assigning account owners gives each lead a dedicated agent, solving the problem of overlap and missed follow-ups.

  • Once an agent is assigned as the owner for a lead/contact, the lead will stop appearing for other agents. However it will still appear to the team-lead of the assigned agent & also to superadmins.
  • Account Owners can be assigned only if your account is on the CRM plan, or, if you have purchased the CRM add-on in your account.

Manual Assignment:
  • During contact creation, assign the Account Owner
  • After creation, open the contact → at the top left, you'll see an option to re-assign the lead to other agents
  • The Account Owner for a lead can only be changed by the team-lead of the assigned owner, or by anyone having the role Superadmin

Automated Assignment:
  • Go to Contact Settings → Account Owner Assignment Rules
  • Define rules based on traits, tags, or lead sources

faqs.question: Can I see a history of all updates on a contact?
faqs.answer:
The Contact Timeline is a chronological view of all activities linked to a contact.It solves the problem of missing context by giving agents full visibility into field and tag updates, changes in status and owner assignments, custom events, notes etc for the contact.

How to view it:
  • Go to Sales CRM → Contacts
  • Click on a contact
  • Open the Timeline tab to see all updates and events

Note - The Timeline shows all activity only for accounts on the CRM plan / having the CRM add-on.

faqs.question: What is a WhatsApp template?
faqs.answer:
To open conversations with a customer who hasn't sent you a message in the previous 24 hours, you need to use a 'template' i.e. a message that has been pre-approved by Meta.

Templates may contain header media and a variety of different buttons like:
  • Quick reply buttons
  • CTA (ie visit website buttons)
  • Catalog buttons (to open up the full catalog / specific products)
  • Copy code button
  • Checkout buttons to open up WhatsApp payment flow
  • Form buttons (to open up WhatsApp Forms)
Templates may also contain Carousels for showing multiple products / services to customers. Moreover, you may also use Templates for sending OTPs (Authentication templates).

faqs.question: What is the difference between Marketing, Utility and Authentication templates?
faqs.answer:
When creating a WhatsApp template, selecting one of the following categories is mandatory:

  • Marketing: Choose this for promotional messages, offers, product announcements, etc.
  • Utility: Use this for non-promotional, service-related updates — such as order confirmations, delivery updates, or account alerts. Avoid selecting this if your message contains promotional content.
  • Authentication: Select this for OTP or verification messages.

Important: Meta reviews each template and may automatically change the category if it doesn’t match the content (e.g., a promotional message marked as Utility will be reclassified as Marketing). You’ll be notified if this happens.

Cost Note: Sending template messages to customers has a per-message charge associated with it. Marketing templates are 5–6x more expensive than Utility templates. Check pricing here

faqs.question: How much time does it take for a template to get approved?
faqs.answer:
In most cases, after template submission, the approval / rejection comes within the first 1 minute itself. However, if the template's status shows pending (yellow) even after 1 minute, then, it implies that WhatsApp might have sent it for manual review, which typically takes up to 24 hours.

The status of a template usually gets updated in real time on the platform. Alternatively, you can click on 'Sync' to sync the latest template status.

faqs.question: How do template variables work?
faqs.answer:
Variables like {{1}}, {{2}}, {{3}} let you personalize messages with names, order IDs, etc. They help tailor communication to each customer, improving click-through and reply rates.

How to use them:
  • Add {{1}}, {{2}}, {{3}} placeholders in the body text while creating the template.
  • You may also add at max 1 variable in the template header (only for text headers).
  • Variables can also be added in a dynamic CTA button in the template.
    Example: For a button containing a customer-specific order link like www.yourstore.com/order/1234, use www.yourstore.com/order{{1}}
  • Don't end the template body content with a variable. It will most likely lead to the template getting rejected.
  • If you are adding multiple variables in the template, make sure you maintain the sequence. For example, if you have 4 variables in your template, they should not be {{1}}, {{2}}, {{4}}, {{5}}. They should be {{1}}, {{2}}, {{3}}, {{4}}

faqs.question: What are the common rejection reasons for templates?
faqs.answer:
1. Parameter Formatting Issues
  • Placeholder variables are incorrectly formatted. The correct format is {{1}}, {{2}}, etc.
  • Variables are not sequential (e.g., using {{1}}, {{2}}, {{4}} without {{3}} will lead to rejection).
  • Too many placeholders compared to the message length — reduce variable count or increase message length.
  • Templates cannot end with a variable placeholder (e.g., ending a message with {{1}} is not allowed).

2. Content & Policy Violations
  • Content violates WhatsApp’s Commerce Policy or Business Policy.
  • Messages contain abusive, misleading, or threatening language.

3. Duplicate Templates
  • Template is identical to an existing approved template, including body and footer.
  • Submitting duplicate content will result in rejection.
Always review your templates thoroughly before submission to avoid delays or rejections.

faqs.question: How can I appeal a template re-categorization by Meta?
faqs.answer:
If Meta has re-categorized your message template (e.g., changed it from Utility to Marketing), you can request a review by following these steps:

  1. Go to Meta Template Manager and log in using the same Meta Business account linked to your WhatsApp API number.
  2. If any templates were re-categorized, you'll see an alert at the top with a link: “Review category updates in Business Support Home.”
  3. Click the alert and go to the 'Template Category Updates' section.
  4. Select the required template and raise a review request.

Note:
  • If you are facing issues while following the above steps, reach out to support@interakt.ai
  • If the template’s content is clearly promotional in nature, the appeal is unlikely to succeed. Only raise appeals for misclassified templates.

faqs.question: How can I send templates to my customers?
faqs.answer:
Once your WhatsApp message template is approved, you can send it to customers through the following methods:

1. Campaigns:
  • Go to: Market → Campaigns → New Campaign → Start from Scratch
  • Select your approved template to use in the campaign.

2. Send Template APIs (Not available on Starter Plan):
  • Use Interakt’s Postman Collection: View API Documentation
  • Fill in the necessary parameters to send templates programmatically.

3. Inbox:
  • In the composer box of your Interakt inbox, click the “Templates” button.
  • Choose a template from the list, fill in the variable values, and send it directly.

faqs.question: How can I ensure that sending campaigns doesn't lead to a number ban?
faqs.answer:
To avoid number bans, it’s crucial to send campaigns only to contacts who have explicitly opted in and are likely to find the message relevant and expected.

Bans typically occur when recipients mark your message as spam, which signals to WhatsApp that your messages are unwanted. To reduce this risk:
  • Carefully select your audience based on engagement and consent.
  • Avoid sending bulk messages to cold or unverified lists.
  • Target users who have shown prior interest or made purchases.
For example: If you're announcing a new product launch, send it only to customers who have placed at least one order and haven’t opted out of marketing messages. These users are far less likely to report your message as spam.

Keeping your messages targeted, timely, and consent-based is key to maintaining a healthy sender reputation on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: My campaign failure rate is too high. What can I do?
faqs.answer:
Marketing templates on WhatsApp are subject to Meta's per-user limit, which means a marketing message will only be delivered if the recipient hasn’t reached their individual limit for receiving such messages. Meta does not disclose what this limit is, so there’s no way to know in advance if a message to a specific recipient will be delivered or not.

This is a safeguard by Meta to prevent users' WhatsApp inboxes from being overwhelmed by marketing messages from multiple brands. As a result, marketing campaigns may see up to 30–50% message delivery failures.

How to Improve Delivery Rates?

You can take the following steps to maximize your campaign reach:

1. Enable Auto-Retries
Turn on auto-retries for your campaign and set the retry window to the maximum (7 days). This ensures that failed messages are automatically retried every 24 hours if they initially failed due to Meta's user limit.

2. Register for Marketing Lite APIs
Meta has introduced a new backend system called Marketing Lite APIs, designed to improve the deliverability of marketing messages.

You can register for it at: https://app.interakt.ai/settings/marketing-lite

faqs.question: How can I send a campaign to a list of contacts stored in Excel / Google Sheet?
faqs.answer:
A) Uploading the Contacts File
  1. Ensure your CSV file contains the following mandatory columns:
    • Phone Number
    • Country Code
    You may include additional custom columns to capture more details about each contact (e.g., name, email, order ID, etc.).
  2. Save the file in CSV format.
  3. Navigate to the Contacts page on Interakt and upload your CSV file. Here’s a quick video guide on how to upload a CSV: How to add bulk contacts to WhatsApp Business API
  4. During upload, map the CSV columns to the appropriate fields in your Interakt workspace.
  5. A tag named Csv upload <date> will automatically be applied to all contacts uploaded in that file.

B) Setting Up the Campaign
  1. Go to Campaigns → New Campaign.
  2. Choose Campaign Type as One-Time, then click on Apply Audience Filters.
  3. Select the tag Csv upload <date> and click Apply Filters.
  4. Select a WhatsApp Message Template for the campaign. You can personalize the message using the CSV column data that you mapped earlier.
  5. Activate Auto-Retries to improve delivery rates.
  6. Set your campaign schedule and click Go Live to launch the campaign.

faqs.question: Where can I check analytics and performance reports for my WhatsApp campaigns on Interakt?
faqs.answer:
For One-Time & Ongoing WhatsApp Campaigns:
  1. Go to Campaigns.
  2. Choose the specific campaign (One-Time or Ongoing) from the list.
  3. You’ll see a dashboard with metrics, including:
    • Attempted
    • Total messages sent
    • Delivered
    • Read
    • Replied
    • Failed
    • Clicks Count
    • Forms Filled (if applicable)
    • Paid Count (if using WhatsApp Pay templates)
  4. In this dashboard, you will also see an option (at the top) to export a Campaign Report to your email id. This report contains message-level details.
  5. If you want to download a report containing data of multiple campaigns together, go to Market → Custom Campaign Reports and select 'Campaign Detailed Report'.

Note: Custom Campaign Reports are only available on select plans.

faqs.question: Why are my campaign's stats not showing up?
faqs.answer:
It might take between a few minutes to hours for a campaign's delivery stats to be updated on the platform (depending on the size of the campaign). Please wait at least 2–3 hours for the campaign's stats to populate.

If you still don't see the stats populated properly, please raise a ticket from the Live Support option, or write to us at support@interakt.ai.

faqs.question: What's the connection between Attempted, Sent, Delivered, Read, Failed?
faqs.answer:
Attempted: Total number of notifications Interakt tried to send to WhatsApp.
➤ Note: Attempted = Sent + Failed

Sent: Notifications that were successfully sent to the recipient's phone, but not necessarily received.
(This is similar to a single tick on WhatsApp — the message has left Interakt but may not have reached the phone if it's switched off or has a poor network.)

Failed: Notifications that could not be sent to the recipient’s phone due to issues like invalid numbers, unregistered users, or system errors.

Delivered: Notifications that were successfully delivered to the recipient's device.
(This is equivalent to a double tick on WhatsApp.)
➤ Note: Delivered is a sub-set of Sent.

Read: Notifications that were read by the recipient, similar to the blue tick in WhatsApp.

Replied: Number of notifications that received a reply within 72 hours of delivery.

faqs.question: How is the cost of a campaign calculated?
faqs.answer:
A campaign's cost is based on two key factors:

1. Number of Delivered Messages

You are charged only for messages that are successfully delivered to recipients.

Messages that fail or are simply sent (but not delivered) do not count toward the cost.
Only delivered messages (those that reach the recipient’s device) are billable.

2. Template Rate

The cost per delivered message is based on the template rate, which varies depending on:

The category of the template (Marketing, Utility, etc.)
Your active subscription plan
The recipient’s country

You can check the exact rates here: https://www.interakt.shop/whatsapp-conversation-pricing/

So, your campaign cost should simply be (1) * (2)
Final Cost = Number of Delivered Messages × Template Rate

Important Note on Utility Templates:
If you're using a Utility template, and the recipient has already messaged your business in the past 24 hours, the message will fall under the user-initiated conversation window and will not incur any additional cost.

faqs.question: What are Workflows on Interakt, and why should I use them?
faqs.answer:
Workflows are chatbot flows that you can set live on your WhatsApp number.

With Interakt's Workflow builder, it is super easy to build elaborate chatbots having multiple branches & logics. You can even call external APIs at different steps of the workflow to fetch customer-specific data / take customer-specific actions.

You can use workflows to:
  • Automatically answer customer FAQs
  • Collect & qualify lead data through questions & forms
  • Address account / order related queries (like order tracking / returns / account summary / etc)
By automating conversations via workflows, you save hours of manual effort in replying to customers & ensure that customers receive quick replies from your business.
  • Automatically answer FAQs
  • Collect lead data through questions and forms
  • Send personalized replies based on user inputs
  • Connect to external systems via APIs
  • Streamline tasks like order tracking, feedback collection, and returns.
By automating these conversations, you reduce manual workload, save time, and deliver a consistent customer experience.

faqs.question: How do I start creating a new workflow in Interakt?
faqs.answer:
To create a new workflow:
  1. Go to your Interakt Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Automation > Workflows
  3. Click on “ + New Workflow”
  4. Choose either a pre-built template or start from scratch
  5. Give your workflow a unique name
You can now begin adding steps, questions, messages, forms, and more.

faqs.question: On which plan are workflows available?
faqs.answer:
Workflows are available on the Growth, Advanced, and Sales CRM plans.

However, the following features are not available in workflows under the Growth and Sales CRM plans:

Branching
API calls (i.e., the Trigger a Webhook action)

To access these features:
If you're on the Growth plan, you'll need to upgrade to the Advanced plan. If you're on the Sales CRM plan, you'll need to purchase the Advanced add-on.

faqs.question: At what points will a workflow (chatbot) get triggered in a customer chat?
faqs.answer:
You may choose to set the following triggers for a workflow (chatbot):
  1. Specific Keywords (Exact Match / Approximate Match ie Contains) - These keywords can be configured as the 1st step of your workflow.
  2. Customer replies to your campaign - This trigger can be configured both from the workflow builder or the campaign creation page. In case you want to create the workflow first & then the campaign, you may skip the trigger step in workflow builder & later, while setting up the campaign, attach the workflow in the campaign.
  3. A new customer messages / existing customer messages after 24 hours - This trigger can only be configured from the Inbox Settings -> Welcome Message section. First, create the workflow (leaving trigger as blank) & then, select the workflow in the Welcome Message.

faqs.question: How can a workflow be triggered when someone replies to my campaign?
faqs.answer:
You can link a workflow to a campaign in two ways:

Option 1: Create the workflow first, then attach it to the campaign
  • While building the workflow, skip the trigger step.
  • In the campaign setup, select this workflow as the Post-Reply Flow.
  • Choose when to trigger the workflow:
    • On any reply
    • On a specific button click
    • On a specific typed response

Option 2: Create the campaign first, then use it as the workflow trigger
  • Set up your campaign (keep it in Draft until the workflow is ready).
  • Do not select a Post-Reply Flow in the campaign setup.
  • While creating the workflow, set the trigger as “User replies to a WhatsApp campaign”.
  • Activate the workflow, then set your campaign live.

faqs.question: How can I save & download a report of my customer's responses?
faqs.answer:
1. Save responses as User Traits (for retargeting)

Use this if you want to filter or retarget customers based on their answers later.
  • In your workflow, while setting a "Send Message" action, click on “Save user response.”
  • Choose “User Trait” (not “Workflow Variable” – that’s for temporary use).
  • Select an existing field or create a new one to store the response.
  • You can later filter contacts using this field and run targeted campaigns.

2. Export responses as a CSV report (for analysis)

Use this if you want to view all responses in Excel.
  • In the Workflow Builder, click “Export Workflow Responses” at the top.
  • Choose your date range and click export — the report will be emailed to you.

faqs.question: What’s the difference between ‘User Trait’ and ‘Workflow Variable’? Which one should I use?
faqs.answer:
Both are used to store customer responses, but they differ in purpose:

User Trait: Stores the response permanently to the user’s profile. Use this for long-term information like name, email, phone number, or preferences that you may want to reuse in future conversations or campaigns.

Workflow Variable: Stores data temporarily during the flow. Use this when you need to process something like an order ID or feedback score that doesn’t need to be stored permanently.

faqs.question: How can I add API calls to fetch / send data at particular steps of the workflow?
faqs.answer:
To make API calls during the workflow, add the 'Trigger a Webhook' action at the step where you want the API call to be made. Note that this is available only on Advanced & Enterprise plans.

This allows you to:
  • Trigger API requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
  • Pass customer data as part of the request
  • Receive data from other systems (e.g., order status, user info)
  • Store the response back as a user trait or workflow variable for dynamic replies
You can configure request headers and body in JSON, test the webhook, and map API response fields directly into your flow.

To know more, go to the section 'Steps to setup Workflows With Webhook' in this article - https://www.interakt.shop/resource-center/how-to-create-workflows-on-interakt/

faqs.question: How do I handle API errors in workflows?
faqs.answer: If your API returns an error (e.g., invalid response or failure to fetch data), you can define a default error message that is shown to the user. In case of such an error, the workflow will stop, and no further steps will be executed to avoid confusion.

faqs.question: Is there a way to export workflow responses and analyze them?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can export the data collected through workflows by:
  1. Clicking on “Export Workflow Responses”
  2. Selecting the date range
  3. Receiving the exported report via your registered email
This report is useful for analyzing leads, feedback, or user behavior.
